newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mandela says committed to privatisation.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mandela says committed to privatisation.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela on Friday pledged his government's commitment to privatising state assets and the phased lifting of foreign exchange controls.
Mandela, however, gave no details on how and when restrictions on taking currency out of the country would be lifted.

Addressing the opening of the 1997 session of parliament, Mandela said the government was accelerating implementation of its macroeconomic plan, adding he believed the country had turned the corner towards consistent economic expansion.
